# KEEPING GREATER AUSTIN STRONG

[Join Today!](https://www.austinymca.org/join/#register)

[Join Today!](https://www.austinymca.org/join/#register)

##### **![🔥](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/16.0.1/svg/1f525.svg) Limited-Time Offer! Enjoy $0 join fee ($49 savings) at any of our 8 community fitness centers! No code needed.**

# **Join the Greater Austin YMCA**

### **Fitness, family, and community all in one place**

No long-term contracts. Real support. A nonprofit organization serving Greater Austin for nearly 75 years. **One membership. Built for real life.**

[JOIN TODAY](https://www.austinymca.org/join/#register)

### What matters most, including…

##### **![👶](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/16.0.1/svg/1f476.svg) Care for them. Time for you.**

Free Kids Play childcare, up to 2 hours each day, while you work out. Ages 6 weeks–12 years with each child cared for in a safe, appropriate setting.

##### **![💪](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/16.0.1/svg/1f4aa.svg) Fitness that fits your life**

40+ group fitness classes each week, including Les Mills BodyPump, BodyCombat, BodyBalance, BodyAttack, yoga, cycling, strength, cardio, and more

##### **![🏊](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/16.0.1/svg/1f3ca.svg) Move your way**

Pools, pickleball, open gym, and more

##### **![🏀](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/16.0.1/svg/1f3c0.svg) Programs for every age**

Youth sports, camps, swim lessons, and more. Members receive special discounted program rates.

##### **![🌎](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/16.0.1/svg/1f30e.svg) Go beyond your home location**

Access to 2,500+ YMCA locations nationwide

### **A safe, welcoming place to belong**

Your health, safety, and peace of mind matter here.

- Trained staff on site
- Background checks for staff and volunteers
- Staff trained in youth safety and prevention
- Clean, well-maintained spaces
- Family-friendly environment
- Welcoming support for all ages and experience levels

![two women stretching in a yoga class](https://www.austinymca.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/keeping-austin-yoga-membership-horizontal-overview-jpg.webp)

![Children wearing goggles and colorful swimsuits cling to the edge of a pool and practice their kicking. The kids are smiling and having fun.](https://www.austinymca.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/keeping-austin-swim-lessons-splash-horizontal-overview-jpg.webp)

### **Choose the membership that fits your life**

All memberships include access to fitness centers, classes, pools, and more.

##### **Membership Rates**

- Student — $25/month
- Young Adult (Ages 19–26) — $49/month
- Adult — $75/month
- Two Adult — $105/month
- One Adult Household — $95/month
- Two Adult Household — $114/month

_**[Financial assistance](https://www.austinymca.org/affordability/)**is available to help ensure wellness for all._

Are you a veteran or an active duty service member? _[**Learn more**](https://www.austinymca.org/membership/military-discounts/)_ about the Y’s free and discounted memberships available to you.

[JOIN TODAY](https://www.austinymca.org/join/#register)

_No contracts. Cancel anytime with 30-day notice. Financial assistance is available for those who qualify._

### **Why people choose the Y**

- A nonprofit organization serving Greater Austin for nearly 75 years
- Welcoming, supportive environment for all experience levels
- Built for families, individuals, and every stage of life
- Financial assistance available to remove barriers
- Your membership helps strengthen the community

### **Get started in minutes**

- Choose your membership
- Join online or visit a center
- Start using your membership right away

You don’t need to have everything figured out. Just start.

### **Prefer to see it first?**

Visit one of our Y locations, meet our team, and explore everything included in your membership.

### **Membership for All**

We believe everyone should have access to the Y. **_[F](https://www.austinymca.org/affordability/)_ [_inancial assistance_](https://www.austinymca.org/affordability/)**is available for individuals and families who qualify.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Below we’ve gathered answers to some of the questions we hear most often from new and returning members. If you’d like to explore additional topics or learn more about how the Y can support you and your family, you can visit our full _[FAQ page](https://www.austinymca.org/faq/)_.

#### [How much does a YMCA membership cost in Austin?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#b8dccb251d524255b)

Memberships range from $25/month to $114/month. Financial assistance is available.

#### [Is there a contract?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#7643c5af4da198c6d)

No. You can cancel anytime with a 30-day notice.

#### [What’s included in membership?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#52cf400ed9f1ee5d7)

Fitness equipment, 40+ weekly classes, pools, pickleball, and more. Household memberships include Kids Play childcare.

#### [Is childcare included?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#c6c555b9ddf59c5f7)

Yes. Kids Play childcare while you work out is included for household memberships.

#### [Can I visit before I join?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#67dc004fa96b688d0)

Yes. Schedule a tour to see the space and meet our team.

#### [When can I start?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#59e972b84c65661e3)

Right away. You can use your membership as soon as you join.

#### [How do I apply for Financial Assistance?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#8cb0f4cbd2a28e7b1)

- The Membership For All program helps make YMCA membership and programs affordable for all through an income-based sliding fee scale. To get started:
- You can join the Y online by choosing your income bracket or you can stop by any of our 8-area locations, and our Welcome Center team can verify your adjusted gross income with your most recent 1040 and sign you up for a membership.
- If you join online, you will need to
  - bring your most recent 1040 tax form to your home branch of the Y within 30 days of joining
  - or upload your documents via a [secure document storage portal online](https://www.austinymca.org/affordability/)
  - (If you do not file, we will ask you to complete Form 4506-T or schedule an appointment with one of our financial assistance coordinators and provide another form of your household income).
- Failure to update your income verification information and bring your most recent tax documentation to the branch will result in your membership increasing to the standard Y membership rate.

#### [How can I cancel my membership?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#29651051c94f58581)

[Membership change requests](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=cSgYx71hmkOlFAS3QUkp_oJiqDPeyw5HhFHdinl8hcZURFI2RkVBSENZNk1IS04xVllYVEZJVzBVUCQlQCN0PWcu)

We are sorry to see you go, but we hope to see you again soon.

We require a 30-day notice to process cancellations. All cancellations must be submitted through the online membership change request form: _**[click here](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=cSgYx71hmkOlFAS3QUkp_oJiqDPeyw5HhFHdinl8hcZURFI2RkVBSENZNk1IS04xVllYVEZJVzBVUCQlQCN0PWcu)**_

As a courtesy, we allow members to place their membership on hold for up to 3 months once a calendar year. All hold requests must be made 10 days in advance via the online membership change request form: [**_click here_**](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=cSgYx71hmkOlFAS3QUkp_oJiqDPeyw5HhFHdinl8hcZURFI2RkVBSENZNk1IS04xVllYVEZJVzBVUCQlQCN0PWcu)

You can change your membership type via the online membership change request form: [**_click here_**](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=cSgYx71hmkOlFAS3QUkp_oJiqDPeyw5HhFHdinl8hcZURFI2RkVBSENZNk1IS04xVllYVEZJVzBVUCQlQCN0PWcu)

Membership type changes may take up to 10 days to process.

#### [How do I log into my Greater Austin YMCA account?](https://www.austinymca.org/join/\#922b58bfa9b1ffd1b)

- Navigate to  “ [Member Login](https://operations.daxko.com/online/2021/Security/login.mvc/find_account)” in the website’s main menu.
- Enter the email address or phone number associated with your Greater Austin YMCA member account and click “Submit.”
- Enter your password or select a 2-factor authentication option to receive a one-time code.

Unable to login? Please contact your YMCA welcome center.
